title: Hatsune Miku — An Imminent Threat〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This banana bread's very good.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I'm glad you like it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This is the bread Kohane and the others told you about, right? The one they had at a cafe in New York!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I decided to bake a loaf after they told us about it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see.
I'm kind of amazed you could just wing the recipe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It's all thanks to Akito for giving me such a detailed report.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Don't forget me and my tireless assistance taste-testing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You mean your tireless mooching, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What? You're making me sound like a thief. I always do my best to give my honest opinion...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Every time I make a new dish, you immediately appear, KAITO. I don't know how it is that you always know...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, something smells delicious!
Does this mean it's snacktime?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
It's banana bread.
Would you like a slice, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Absolutely!
While you're at it, can I also get a latte?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, fine. Just give me a second to get everything ready.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Humhumhumm...♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You've been humming that song quite a lot recently, Luka. Is that one of the ones the American street musicians were singing?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's right. I heard it the last time I went over to see how everyone was doing! And now I just can't get the melody out of my head.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's apparently a traditional folk song, they said. It's really struck a chord with me for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Humhumhumm♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
MEIKO!
You gotta make us more of those giant hamburgers!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And shakes and fries!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't realize that you two liked those American-sized burgers so much.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I can understand why.
The ones Akito and the others brought over were eye-popping in size, and taste too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I couldn't believe it when I first saw them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, that ice cream they brought over was also pretty staggering. I mean, they came in big buckets.

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: Wait, the ice cream!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: There's still some in the freezer, right?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's have some while we wait for our burgers!
se_walk_men_004_1
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's almost all gone...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That can't be right! There was so much!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, if the ice cream's gone, then that must mean...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? No, I'm innocent!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Remember those new, giant parfaits we've been having lately?! Don't tell me you all forgot!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We used that ice cream to make them, right, MEIKO?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, and scoops upon scoops of it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Giant parfaits...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: W-We have been ordering those a lot, huh.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Then, KAITO really is innocent!
W-We're so sorry we doubted you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Still, we've been getting quite a nice taste of American culture lately.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We have to thank Kohane and the others for that!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Not only have they been telling us all about what things are like over there, they've even been bringing over delicious food.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Right.
Although, a part of me feels that we're being affected a little too much...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I don't see a problem with that.
We may not get to experience this again for quite some time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, why don't we follow their lead and keep enjoying what the United States has to offer?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, you have a point.
This is a nice change of pace.
